condition_descriptions.full: all modalities available; title/artist injection follows INJECT_TITLE
condition_descriptions.wo_video: video feature is zeroed; title/artist injection follows INJECT_TITLE
condition_descriptions.wo_audio_feature_only: music feature is zeroed, but title/artist metadata is kept
condition_descriptions.wo_audio_all: music feature is zeroed and title/artist metadata injection is disabled
condition_descriptions.wo_prompt: text prompt feature and user text are removed; title/artist metadata is kept
condition_descriptions.wo_ltp: long-term preference feature is zeroed; title/artist metadata is kept
